verdict.rationale: GrowthBook publishes a pricing page with tiers. The Free tier lists "Up to 3 users" and "1 project" alongside "Unlimited feature flags", "Unlimited experiments" and "Unlimited traffic", which suggests seats drive cost rather than MAUs, events or requests. Higher tiers are described by their added features. However, the evidence shows no dollar amounts or per-seat rates, so a PM cannot actually work out what they would pay. missing for 10: actual published price figures for paid tiers, explicit per-seat or usage-based cost explanation for Pro/Enterprise, independent corroboration of pricing clarity.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can see published pricing and understand what drives cost (seats, MAUs, events, requests) before committing
